sources.snippet: In this blog, we will give an in-detail explanation of how XLS-R - more specifically the pre-trained checkpoint Wav2Vec2-XLS-R-300M - can be fine-tuned for ASR. For demonstration purposes, we fine-tune the model on the low resource ASR dataset of Common Voice that contains only ca. 4h of validated training data. sources.snippet: Overview wav2vec2-xls-r-300m is facebook's 300-million-parameter multilingual speech representation model built on the wav2vec 2.0 architecture. The model undergoes pretraining on 436,000 hours of unlabeled speech across 128 languages using datasets including VoxPopuli, MLS, CommonVoice, BABEL, and VoxLingua107.
